build_volume_note: Main nozzle printing area as printed: 256*256*260 mm. The sheet gives 235.5*256*256 mm for the auxiliary nozzle and for dual-nozzle printing.
max_flow_note: Printed as 40 mm^3/s for the hotend, tested with a 250 mm round model, a single outer wall, Bambu Lab ABS at 280 C. A real cabinet prints slower than this, so a print time computed from it is a lower bound.
